findings.suggestedVerification: Batch the fetch outside the loop (WHERE id IN (...)) or use a collection query that returns all rows at once.

findings.title: Broken async API chain [BUG-ASYNC-CHAIN]
findings.impact: Failures may be silently ignored, leaving the system in a partial state.
findings.explanation: Nested .then() pipeline has no .catch() — a mid-chain rejection silently drops data (fetch → parse → transform → store). Detected in C:\Users\User\Downloads\BUSINESS\INFRASTRUCTURE\recourse\src\lib\liveOncologyGraph.ts:365.
findings.suggestedVerification: Add .catch() at the end of the chain or refactor to async/await inside try/catch.

findings.title: Integer overflow beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER [NUM-OVERFLOW]
findings.impact: Can produce results that violate the intended business rule.
findings.explanation: Arithmetic on a number-typed value can exceed 2^53-1 — precision silently lost for counters, ids, or large sums. Detected in C:\Users\User\Downloads\BUSINESS\INFRASTRUCTURE\recourse\src\lib\liveOncologyGraph.ts:135.
findings.suggestedVerification: Use BigInt or a bignum library for values that can exceed MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and validate bounds.

findings.title: Race condition on shared mutable state (read-modify-write) [BUG-RACE-REWRITE]
findings.impact: Can produce lost updates, double-spend, or deadlock under concurrent execution.
findings.explanation: Shared state is mutated via a non-atomic read-modify-write without a mutex, transaction, or atomic primitive. Detected in C:\Users\User\Downloads\BUSINESS\INFRASTRUCTURE\recourse\src\lib\mathConductor.ts:585.
findings.suggestedVerification: Wrap the mutation in a Mutex runExclusive block or convert to an atomic SQL increment (SET x = x + 1).
